name: job-hunt-assistant
description: Comprehensive job search automation using AgentGPT autonomous agents

commands.name: job-search
commands.description: Search for jobs matching your profile and preferences
examples: /job-search Senior Software Engineer in Remote - focus on AI/ML, min $150k
/job-search Product Manager in San Francisco - 5+ years experience, B2B SaaS
/job-search Full Stack Developer in New York - React, Node.js, startup culture

commands.name: tailor-resume
commands.description: Tailor your resume for a specific job posting
examples: /tailor-resume Senior Developer at Google - requiring Python, Go, distributed systems

commands.name: company-research
commands.description: Deep research on a company before applying or interviewing

commands.name: interview-prep
commands.description: Prepare for an interview with company-specific questions
examples: /interview-prep Google Senior SWE - system design, algorithms

commands.name: application-tracker
commands.description: Track and manage your job applications
examples: /application-tracker add - Applied to Google SWE role, stage: Applied
/application-tracker update - Google moved to Phone Screen

commands.name: networking
commands.description: Find and research people to network with at target companies

commands.name: salary-research
commands.description: Research competitive salary ranges for a role
examples: /salary-research Senior Software Engineer in SF - 8 years experience
/salary-research Product Manager in Remote - L6 equivalent

commands.name: cover-letter
commands.description: Generate a tailored cover letter for a job
examples: /cover-letter Anthropic AI Safety Engineer - highlight ML research background

RESUME_DATA_PATH.description: Path to your ResuMme Monster data or resume JSON

LINKEDIN_PROFILE.description: Your LinkedIn profile URL for context

TARGET_ROLES.description: Comma-separated list of target role titles
